notes: EBIT definition gap: D.R. Horton’s consolidated income statement does not present an explicit “Operating income/EBIT” line item; this package uses “Income before income taxes” as the EBIT proxy for historical values and for ebit_margin modeling. ([sec.gov](https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/882184/000088218425000081/dhi-20250930.htm))

NWC construction: NWC proxy = (Inventories total + Mortgage loans held for sale) − (Accounts payable + Accrued expenses and other liabilities). This excludes cash/restricted cash, deferred taxes, and other assets to keep the NWC used in DCF aligned to operating working-capital needs. ([sec.gov](https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/882184/000088218425000081/dhi-20250930.htm))

Capex definition: Capex uses “Expenditures for property and equipment” from the consolidated cash flow statement. ([sec.gov](https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/882184/000088218425000081/dhi-20250930.htm))

Tax rate: base-case tax_rate uses management guidance (~24.5%) rather than the FY2023–FY2025 effective tax rate average to better align with current-year expectations. ([investor.drhorton.com](https://investor.drhorton.com/news-and-events/press-releases/2026/01-20-2026-113048753))
Current price source: finance quote reflects the latest trade prior to 2026-03-21 (tool latest trade date shows 2026-03-20).

NOL fields: nol_balance is taken from the deferred tax assets table line “Net operating loss carryforwards” (tax-effected disclosure). nol_utilization_pct is modeled as 0.80 due to limited consolidated utilization detail for all state jurisdictions (federal utilization expectation described in filing). ([sec.gov](https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/882184/000088218425000081/dhi-20250930.htm))

Comps limitations: EV/NTM revenue and EV/NTM EBITDA were set to null because the free market-data sources accessed provided forward P/E but not the EV/NTM breakouts required by the schema. ([stockanalysis.com](https://stockanalysis.com/stocks/phm/))

catalysts: Sustained improvement in affordability (primarily mortgage rates and incentive levels) leading to higher net sales orders and faster home-start absorption. ([investor.drhorton.com](https://investor.drhorton.com/news-and-events/press-releases/2026/01-20-2026-113048753))

Any upward revision to fiscal 2026 guidance for revenue/home closes or operating cash flow. ([investor.drhorton.com](https://investor.drhorton.com/news-and-events/press-releases/2026/01-20-2026-113048753))

Share repurchase execution and relative valuation support if earnings power recovers through the cycle. ([investor.drhorton.com](https://investor.drhorton.com/news-and-events/press-releases/2026/01-20-2026-113048753))
company_overview: National U.S. homebuilder and provider of mortgage and title services; also operates rental and has a majority-owned Forestar business. ([investor.drhorton.com](https://investor.drhorton.com/news-and-events/press-releases/2026/01-20-2026-113048753))

Homebuilding scale supported by a large footprint across U.S. markets and lifecycle demand drivers (household formation, demographics, and affordability). ([investor.drhorton.com](https://investor.drhorton.com/news-and-events/press-releases/2026/01-20-2026-113048753))

Fiscal year ends September 30; consolidated revenues historically in the mid-$30B range depending on home-close volume and mix. ([sec.gov](https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/882184/000088218425000081/dhi-20250930.htm))
current_context: Fiscal 2026 Q1 (quarter ended Dec 31, 2025): consolidated revenues of $6.9B and consolidated pre-tax income of $798.1M (pre-tax profit margin 11.6%). ([investor.drhorton.com](https://investor.drhorton.com/news-and-events/press-releases/2026/01-20-2026-113048753))

Management reiterated fiscal 2026 guidance: consolidated revenues of $33.5B to $35.0B; home closes 86,000 to 88,000; income tax rate ~24.5%; operating cash flow at least $3.0B. ([investor.drhorton.com](https://investor.drhorton.com/news-and-events/press-releases/2026/01-20-2026-113048753))

Capital return remains active: guidance includes share repurchases of ~ $2.5B and dividend payments of ~ $500M. ([investor.drhorton.com](https://investor.drhorton.com/news-and-events/press-releases/2026/01-20-2026-113048753))
investment_highlights: Base-case revenue growth set to align with the fiscal 2026 guidance range and a normalization path thereafter, reflecting cyclicality of homebuilding volumes and incentives. ([investor.drhorton.com](https://investor.drhorton.com/news-and-events/press-releases/2026/01-20-2026-113048753))

EBIT margin is modeled as mean-reverting from FY2025's lower level toward a mid-cycle operating profile consistent with housing normalization, with tax rate anchored to management’s guidance. ([sec.gov](https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/882184/000088218425000081/dhi-20250930.htm))

Capital intensity is held near historical capex as a percent of sales, while D&A as a percent of sales remains stable for a modeling-consistent run-rate. ([sec.gov](https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/882184/000088218425000081/dhi-20250930.htm))

Working-capital assumptions use an operating NWC proxy (inventory + mortgage loans held for sale minus accounts payable and accrued expenses), capturing inventory-driven cash conversion typical for builders. ([sec.gov](https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/882184/000088218425000081/dhi-20250930.htm))
key_risks: Housing demand softness from consumer affordability constraints and elevated mortgage-rate volatility. ([investor.drhorton.com](https://investor.drhorton.com/news-and-events/press-releases/2026/01-20-2026-113048753))

Margin compression risk from higher cost inflation, less favorable pricing, or elevated incentive usage impacting operating leverage. ([investor.drhorton.com](https://investor.drhorton.com/news-and-events/press-releases/2026/01-20-2026-113048753))

Working-capital cash conversion risk (inventory builds vs. close timing) given the inventory-heavy operating model. ([sec.gov](https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/882184/000088218425000081/dhi-20250930.htm))

Tax and credit environment changes (including impact to effective tax rate components) could shift realized tax rate vs. model assumptions. ([investor.drhorton.com](https://investor.drhorton.com/news-and-events/press-releases/2026/01-20-2026-113048753))
